title: Enhancing Public Awareness of Special Needs Children and Needs of Their Parents and Caregivers
what_it_is: Enhancing Public Awareness of Special Needs Children and Needs of Their Parents and Caregivers

sections.label: Inclusion of persons with disabilities
sections.summary: NCSS campaigns and the Enabling Masterplan promote inclusion of persons with disabilities, including inclusive playgrounds and workplace support for parents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: One such effort is the National Council of Social Service's (NCSS') "See the True Me" campaign, a five-year public education initiative that started in 2016 to promote the inclusion of persons with disabilities in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Over the last two years, NCSS has also held campaigns promoting inclusiveness across various platforms which reached over three million people in Singapore and engaged about 95,000 members of the public.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Building an inclusive society and raising the public's awareness and understanding of persons with disabilities and their caregivers are a continuous work in progress.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: This is why the third Enabling Masterplan includes efforts that start with the young, so that we can nurture future generations of citizens who care for others.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For example, the building of inclusive playgrounds at our public parks has enabled children with special needs to play with other children and also serve as a platform to enhance awareness of children with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) works closely with other Government agencies, such as the Ministry of Manpower, and the tripartite partners to encourage employers and the broad community to support parents in the workplace.

sections.label: Work-Life Grant and FWAs
sections.summary: The Work-Life Grant funds employers to sustain FWAs, and tripartite partners developed a Tripartite Standard on FWAs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Work-Life Grant provides employers with funding support to sustain FWAs and defray the costs of implementing these measures at the workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In addition, the tripartite partners have also jointly developed a Tripartite Standard on FWAs to help jobseekers and employees identify progressive employers with strong support for FWAs.

sections.label: FWAs and caring community
sections.summary: With FWAs, the aim is to build a caring community, involving the heart and mind of people including employers.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: With FWAs, we also want to reach out to more to see how we can build not only about having legislation but it is about the heart and mind of our people, including employers, when we want to see and build a community that cares for one another.
